explanation: Mathlib has `AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_eq_one_iff` in `Mathlib/FieldTheory/Normal/Defs.lean`, but it applies when the subfield is an `IntermediateField` of the ambient field. This theorem instead treats `L` as an arbitrary field in a scalar tower and states the condition on its image under `algebraMap`; transporting between these settings requires additional work, so the Mathlib result is not a duplicate or a permitted short special-case derivation. I also searched for other `restrictNormal` identity criteria. The proof uses `AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes`, not the identity criterion.
